# Exploding Topics

> > Exploding Topics identifies and tracks rapidly growing trends, emerging technologies, and market insights across industries using data-driven trend discovery and analytics.

The platform provides trend discovery tools, website traffic rankings, and comprehensive reports on emerging topics across categories like AI tools, social media platforms, and industry-specific trends. Exploding Topics serves marketers, investors, and researchers with actionable intelligence through its Pro platform and Trends API.

## Key Topics

- Trend Discovery
- Market Research
- Emerging Trends
- Website Rankings
- Traffic Analytics
- AI Tools
- Social Media Platforms
- Exploding Topics Pro
- Trends API
- Startup Tracking
- SEO Tools
- Keyword Research
- Industry Analytics
- Trending Topics

## Core Platform

- [Exploding Topics - Discover the hottest new trends](https://explodingtopics.com/): Homepage for discovering hottest emerging trends and market insights

## Trend Reports & Rankings

- [65 Most Popular AI Tools Ranked (February 2026)](https://explodingtopics.com/blog/most-popular-ai-tools): Ranking of 65 most popular AI tools as of February 2026
- [Top 35 Social Media Platforms (January 2026)](https://explodingtopics.com/blog/top-social-media-platforms): Comprehensive ranking of top 35 social media platforms in 2026

## Website Analytics & Industry Rankings

- [Most Visited Chemicals Websites in the United States - Updated February 2026](https://analytics.explodingtopics.com/website/united-states/chemicals): Real-time rankings of most visited Chemicals websites in United States
